collections.title: $20 Sale
collections.description:
Calling all boutique clothing lovers! Just when you think shopping with us couldn’t get any better – we do something awesome like having a $20 sale. It’s a fun event where a bunch of our great-looking styles are available for one low price. What can you find at this sale? We're sure you're going to see some of your favorites, plus some of our bestselling items. Take a few moments to browse our fabulous deals and treat yourself to some new outfit pieces and accessories to enhance and expand your expressive sense of personal style. Due to the popularity of this special sales event, we can’t guarantee how long any item is going to be available, so shop now and get what you want!

Don’t see anything featured here? Our limited time $20 sale has ended for now. However, you can be among the first to get in on the next one by signing up for our timely alerts.

Find a Great Dress

The best dresses are ones that are effortless to wear and make you look fabulous all day long. Our boutique is your go-to place to find fashionable, comfortable dresses to wear for any occasion. Find dresses to wear to the beach, dresses to wear to work, dresses to wear for parties and special occasions and dresses to wear on vacation. We’ve got the lengths you love – short mini dresses, dresses that fall just above the knee, mid-length midi dresses, and the long maxi lengths you love. And our dress style selection is second to none. 

Stylish Tops and Bottoms

Have you been thinking about getting more tops and bottoms? Go for it! A $20 sale is the best time to add more of these essential pieces to your wardrobe. Our tops come in a wide array of colors and patterns that reflect your style. Choose tank tops, blouses, tees, sweaters and cardigans to go with any of our bottoms. As for bottoms, we have leggings, jeans, skirts, lounge pants and shorts. 

Grab Those Accessories

Enhance your personal style with our selection of trendy accessories offered at this limited time price. There are all sorts of accessory items to discover, including jewelry, sunglasses, hats, blankets, handbags and more.

collections.title: $25 and Under Sale!
collections.description:
Women's Boutique Styles Under $25

Looking for cute boutique clothing without the boutique price tag? You've come to the right place! Shop our $25 & Under Sale to score the latest women's fashion at prices you'll love. From trendy graphic tees and cozy sweaters to must-have tops, dresses, denim, accessories, and more, it's never been easier to refresh your wardrobe on a budget.

Whether you're shopping for everyday basics, weekend outfits, vacation styles, or seasonal favorites, you'll find affordable fashion that keeps you looking stylish without overspending. Our collection is filled with the girly details you love—from soft florals and playful prints to feminine silhouettes and on-trend colors.

Don't wait to shop! These budget-friendly boutique finds are available for a limited time, and popular sizes and styles sell out fast. Grab your favorites from our $25 & Under Sale today and discover why Pink Lily is your go-to destination for cute, affordable women's clothing and accessories.

collections.title: 2025 Holiday Gift Guide
collections.description:
Clueless about what to get your loved ones for the holidays this year? Well, we happen to have the fun, fashionable gifts you’re looking for. Our holiday gift guide is packed with unique and thoughtful ideas for everyone on your list, from friends and family to teachers, coworkers and more. If you know someone with an eye for on-trend fashion, they’ll love the stylish items you can find in this collection.

Unique Gifts for the Holidays

When you want to show your love and appreciation for the people in your life, you need gifts that are just as special as they are. That’s exactly what you’ll find in this guide. Here are just some of the ideas we love for holiday gifting:

  • For your besties: Instead of friendship bracelets, get everyone in your crew matching tumblers. Choose a monogram style to make each one unique.
  • For your family: Surprise your sister or niece with a cool hair scarf, or give Mom a modern watch band that will make her feel totally hip.
  • For the helpers: Give babysitters, teachers and other people who play a special role in your life a chance to pamper themselves with a cozy robe or slippers.

Create a Custom Care Package

We love the idea of combining multiple items to create a thoughtful and meaningful gift for someone special. Here are a few themed gift ideas to get you started:

  • Cozy: Put a soft scarf, a pair of slippers and a travel mug (for hot cocoa, of course!) in a stocking.
  • Glam: Pick out a stylish purse, then place makeup brushes, self-tanner and a leopard print monogram tee inside as bonus gifts.
  • Style: Provide multiple hair styling options with fun accessories, like a knotted headband, a satin hair scarf and a too-cute beanie.

Check out the full selection of fresh fashions from Pink Lily to find even more holiday gift options. It’s an easy, affordable and fun way to make the season merry and bright!

collections.title: A Pink Lily Holiday
collections.description:
The holidays are here! Make sure you're ready to bundle up next to the fire with cozy one-piece and two-piece pajama sets from Pink Lily. Stay comfy at all the holiday parties with our soft and warm holiday sweaters with matching accessories. Plus, our matching mommy & me Christmas graphic sweatshirts are perfect for running around getting your shopping done with your little ones. 

Holiday Graphics for Women

Everyday you want to show your personality, but it's even more fun around the holidays. Here at Pink Lily, we make that easy with our comfortable and high quality graphic tees and sweatshirts. Show your love for Christmas with colorful graphic tees and sweatshirts featuring favorite holiday designs. Pinklily.com also has many mommy & me options to choose from for those matching sets of graphic tees and graphic sweatshirts so you and your whole crew will coordinate for all the cutest photo ops this year!

Coordinating Pajama Sets

Getting your matching family Christmas pajamas is super fun and easy at PinkLily.com. This collection features complete sets that coordinate effortlessly for the perfect Christmas Eve looks. With matching men's pajamas, women's pajamas, and kid's pajamas in colorful fair isle prints, your whole family will be so cute on Christmas morning. 

Stylish Christmas Sweaters

Don't forget about those holiday parties! There are many stylish and cozy sweaters in solid colors and prints that set you up for the perfect outfit for any get together this season. Shop now at Pink Lily and get your Christmas party outfit with matching accessories!

collections.title: $20 Sale
collections.description:
Calling all boutique clothing lovers! Just when you think shopping with us couldn’t get any better – we do something awesome like having a $20 sale. It’s a fun event where a bunch of our great-looking styles are available for one low price. What can you find at this sale? Take a few moments to browse our fabulous deals and treat yourself to some new outfit pieces and accessories to enhance and expand your expressive sense of personal style. Due to the popularity of this special sales event, we can’t guarantee how long any item is going to be available, so shop now and get what you want!

Find a Great Dress

The best dresses are ones that are effortless to wear and make you look fabulous all day long. Our boutique is your go-to place to find fashionable, comfortable dresses to wear for any occasion. Find dresses to wear to the beach, dresses to wear to work, dresses to wear for parties and special occasions and dresses to wear on vacation. We’ve got the lengths you love – short mini dresses, dresses that fall just above the knee, mid-length midi dresses, and the long maxi lengths you love. And our dress style selection is second to none. 

Stylish Tops and Bottoms

Have you been thinking about getting more tops and bottoms? Go for it! A $20 sale is the best time to add more of these essential pieces to your wardrobe. Our tops come in a wide array of colors and patterns that reflect your style. Choose tank tops, blouses, tees, sweaters and cardigans to go with any of our bottoms. As for bottoms, we have leggings, jeans, skirts, lounge pants and shorts. 

Grab Those Accessories

Enhance your personal style with our selection of trendy accessories offered at this limited time price. There are all sorts of accessory items to discover, including jewelry, sunglasses, hats, blankets, handbags and more.

collections.title: 2025 Holiday Gift Guide
collections.description:
Clueless about what to get your loved ones for the holidays this year? Well, we happen to have the fun, fashionable gifts you’re looking for. Our holiday gift guide is packed with unique and thoughtful ideas for everyone on your list, from friends and family to teachers, coworkers and more. If you know someone with an eye for on-trend fashion, they’ll love the stylish items you can find in this collection.

Unique Gifts for the Holidays

When you want to show your love and appreciation for the people in your life, you need gifts that are just as special as they are. That’s exactly what you’ll find in this guide. Here are just some of the ideas we love for holiday gifting:

  • For your besties: Instead of friendship bracelets, get everyone in your crew matching tumblers. Choose a monogram style to make each one unique.
  • For your family: Surprise your sister or niece with a cool hair scarf, or give Mom a modern watch band that will make her feel totally hip.
  • For the helpers: Give babysitters, teachers and other people who play a special role in your life a chance to pamper themselves with a cozy robe or slippers.

Create a Custom Care Package

We love the idea of combining multiple items to create a thoughtful and meaningful gift for someone special. Here are a few themed gift ideas to get you started:

  • Cozy: Put a soft scarf, a pair of slippers and a travel mug (for hot cocoa, of course!) in a stocking.
  • Glam: Pick out a stylish purse, then place makeup brushes, self-tanner and a leopard print monogram tee inside as bonus gifts.
  • Style: Provide multiple hair styling options with fun accessories, like a knotted headband, a satin hair scarf and a too-cute beanie.

Check out the full selection of fresh fashions from Pink Lily to find even more holiday gift options. It’s an easy, affordable and fun way to make the season merry and bright!
